statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-61711 (GO-2026-6255, GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6): before BuildKit 0.31.1, a custom frontend could put an invalid SecurityMode value in a build request, and the BuildKit daemon's executor treated the unknown value as a non-sandbox mode without requiring the security.insecure entitlement, which disabled Seccomp and AppArmor for that build container. It is fixed in BuildKit 0.31.1 by commit 3ea6dd0 (security: validate exec security modes), which makes the daemon's executor reject unknown modes and also makes the LLB client library's (*ExecOp).Marshal refuse to serialize one: https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6255, https://github.com/moby/buildkit/commit/3ea6dd0ce7d269cdb8aa23348718e2c1bf64f109, https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.31.1. Read the Go build information and the function table (with a reader of the Go symbol table that also works on stripped binaries) of every Go program in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 89 builds, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, every download checked against the index checksum. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index; the copy the repository serves, which matches one of those entries' checksum, was read. Each package holds one file, the frontend Go program /usr/bin/build. runtime.main is found in the function table of every Go program scanned, so the tables were read. This package is a BuildKit frontend, the program that sends build requests to the daemon, not the daemon: no function table of any Go program in any build contains BuildKit executor code (executor/...), its LLB solver (solver/llbsolver) or its control API server (control). It does carry the client half of the fix: the frontend program contains github.com/moby/buildkit/client/llb.(*ExecOp).Marshal, one of the functions the fix commit changes, in every build, so the status follows the BuildKit version. Every build before 2.20.0-r8 embeds BuildKit 0.26.3 to 0.29.0, inside the affected range; 2.20.0-r8 and every later build embed 0.31.1 or newer. The error text the fix adds, "invalid security mode" (from pb.ValidateSecurityMode in BuildKit's solver/pb package, which (*ExecOp).Marshal now calls), is in the frontend program of the build 2.20.0-r8 package (x86_64) and the build-fips 2.20.0-r8 package (aarch64) and absent from both 2.20.0-r7 packages, while BuildKit's client/llb strings are in all four. The current 2.29.1-r1 embeds BuildKit 0.33.0.

statements.impact_statement: GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6 (CVE-2026-61711, GO-2026-6255): a custom BuildKit frontend could send an invalid SecurityMode in a build request, which the BuildKit executor (executor/oci/spec_linux.go) treated as a non-sandbox mode, disabling Seccomp and AppArmor for the build container. Fixed in BuildKit 0.31.1 by https://github.com/moby/buildkit/commit/3ea6dd0ce7d269cdb8aa23348718e2c1bf64f109 (validating exec security modes in executor/oci, solver/pb and client/llb); see https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go program for Linux (CGO_ENABLED=0 in every build). We read the Go build information (go version -m) and the function table (go tool nm) of /usr/bin/trivy in all 38 trivy-dev builds published for Alpine 3.23 as of 2026-11-27 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r12), on both x86_64 and aarch64. trivy uses BuildKit only to parse Dockerfiles: the only github.com/moby/buildkit packages linked in any build are frontend/dockerfile/command, instructions, linter, parser and shell, util/stack and util/suggest. No build links any function from executor/oci, solver or client/llb, where build containers are created and their security mode is applied, while runtime.main and the frontend/dockerfile/parser functions are found in every build by the same search. A byte search of /usr/bin/trivy in trivy 0.69.1-r0 (x86_64) and 0.74.0-r12 (aarch64) agrees: github.com/moby/buildkit/executor, github.com/moby/buildkit/solver, github.com/moby/buildkit/client/llb and SecurityMode_INSECURE occur 0 times, while github.com/moby/buildkit/frontend/dockerfile/parser occurs over 100 times. The vulnerable code is not in this package.

GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6 (CVE-2026-61711, GO-2026-6255): a custom BuildKit frontend could send an invalid SecurityMode in a build request, which the BuildKit executor (executor/oci/spec_linux.go) treated as a non-sandbox mode, disabling Seccomp and AppArmor for the build container. Fixed in BuildKit 0.31.1 by https://github.com/moby/buildkit/commit/3ea6dd0ce7d269cdb8aa23348718e2c1bf64f109 (validating exec security modes in executor/oci, solver/pb and client/llb); see https://github.com/moby/buildkit/security/advisories/GHSA-7236-3392-c5c6.
